title: Trust Canal build request gate
goal: Admit a build request only for canonical MISSING_WORK with a deterministic proposed local route, without invoking the selected builder.
laws: Build request requires canonical primary mission identity.
Server recomputes preflight and route; client cannot forge MISSING_WORK or builder choice.
Only ROUTE_PROPOSED with PRIMARY available local labor may request build.
Exact route SHA-256 is bound into the Trust Canal request.
Admission does not invoke a model, worker, Talos, or Hephaestus.
